caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a metal handle or door pull, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a beige background. In the center of the page, there is a shaded, three-dimensional front view of the handle, showing an arched bar connecting two rounded mounting plates, each with three visible screw holes. On the left side, an outline of the same handle is presented from a top or bottom view, showing the contours and hole placements without shading. On the upper right, there is an outline of the handle from the side, revealing its curved profile, and a horizontal line labeled "scale of inches" ranging from 0 to 3 ½ below it for reference. The three main views are enclosed in separate, neatly drawn rectangles. The name "Donald Spencer" is inscribed in small letters in the bottom right corner outside the primary drawing area. The composition is monochromatic, primarily utilizing light and dark pencil shading to convey form, depth, and dimensional relationships between the objects.
title: Hand Forged Latch
